Not every cue needs changing: Quick Level now checks first. A cue within 1 LU of the target, with peaks under the ceiling, nothing to even out and no source problems is marked Already good.
Already-good cues are left untouched: an exact copy goes into the Levelled folder (same naming), and the report says No change needed.
The right panel shows why a cue is already good, compared with your reference library.
